hooks.commandWindows: & { $python = Get-Command python.exe -CommandType Application -ErrorAction Stop; if ([IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($python.Source) -eq (Get-Location).ProviderPath) { throw 'Python must be installed outside the hook working directory' }; & ($python.Source) -I -c "import os, runpy, sys; sys.argv[0] = os.path.join(os.environ['PLUGIN_ROOT'], 'scripts', 'claude-obsidian.py'); runpy.run_path(sys.argv[0], run_name='__main__')" hook session-start; exit $LASTEXITCODE }
